lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Target down!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Rip out the core! It's the only way to stop it from regenerating!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Behemoth! Grab on!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Time to fly!
*Vrrrrrr!*
Rapi deploys Seven Dwarves Zero and soars into the sky while carrying Behemoth.
They fly up to until they are in front of Liberalio's body's falling core, where she deploys her drill.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'll use the drill to grind down the area around the core, then you rip it out with your claws!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Okay! Leave it to me!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Pierce through it!
*Booom!*
A massive beam of light flashes past Rapi and Behemoth as they charge forward.
And pierces right through the core of Liberalio's body and the surrounding parts.
Liberalio's body begins to crumble and vanish.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Pierced right through it.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I wasn't talking to you. I was talking to Seven Dwarves.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I use Seven Dwarves too.
Rapi and Behemoth land on the ground.
Everyone takes a step forward.
They gaze at Altruia and Egovista.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Magnificent.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: They defeated the one once hailed as the strongest, mindless though it may have been...

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I can feel myself being moved to tears.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: 'Tis our cue to fight.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I had thought to reserve my strength...

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Though, I grant little could be expected of the aged Sea Nettle.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: In the end, the weightiest matters are best dispatched by one's own hand.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Where's the Queen?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: You needn't concern yourself with the safety of our great mother.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: The only thing within your power is to choose how you perish here.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Is she hiding in the Lift?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Mother neither flees nor hides!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Your mother is a spineless coward.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: She couldn't win on her own, so she stole Liliweiss's body.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Now that I hear it out loud, she's basically a common thief.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Hold thy tongue. I'll hear no more.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I had thought only to watch, in pity, thine attempt to prolong thy time.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: But I cannot abide such slander of our mother.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: In what manner wouldst thou have me cleave thy pate? Vertically? Horizontally? Perhaps diagonally?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Why don't you ask your mommy?
Altruia and Egovista charge forward, their faces contorted in rage.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What're you trying to do by provoking them? We're all exhausted.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: They're the ones stalling for time. They clearly have some sort of plan.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Still, you should find other ways to provoke someone moving forward.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Levi. Ziz. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... I'm all right.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: M-me too. I think.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, the wise Bahamut, am perfectly fine. Because I did not fight.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You know, the new Heretics the Queen made...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: are probably even bigger monsters than the Offsprings.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: A-are you scared?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Who said I'm scared?!
The two Heretics draw increasingly closer.
Altruia deploys a massive electromagnetic field and pushes it forward.
Egovista charges in as if ready to bring down her sword at any moment.
Counters and Snow White, you handle Altruia. You've fought her before, which should make her relatively easier to handle.
Four Beasts, you take Egovista. She's skilled in close-quarters combat, so Behemoth will have to bear the brunt of it.
Everyone nods.
The Heretics get even closer.
Soon, they will be within firing range.
Everyone, g—

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Squander not thy vigor upon trifles.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Leave this to us.
A shining golden barrier appears before us.
And at its center,
there stands a saint, shining brighter than everything else.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Sorry to keep you waiting. Everything will be okay now.
Then the swordswoman casually steps in front of us.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Take a moment's respite. I shall fell them in a single stroke.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Scarlet...! Rapunzel...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Reserve thy tears till a later hour.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: We need to teach these impostors a lesson first.
Scarlet and Rapunzel gaze at the incoming Altruia and Egovista,
then dash forward.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: It is an honor to finally meet you, Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: ... How vulgar.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Sister Noah's shields are not something the likes of you should imitate.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I will destroy them.
Light shoots out from the halo floating behind Rapunzel.
At the same time, Rapunzel charges forward.
Altruia and Rapunzel clash, both having deployed their barriers.
The air is filled with the sound of battle.
Golden and green particles scatter about violently.
What seemed like a close back-and-forth quickly tilts to one side.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: ... I'm being overwhelmed...? Me?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I told you. You are not worthy to bear those shields.
Suddenly, there is a loud hum.
The red components on part of Rapunzel's halo begin to glow.
She floats into the air and surges forward with a ferocious momentum.
As Rapunzel pushes forward, Altruia's barrier grows thinner and dimmer.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Oh my. You seem to be the type who crumbles when someone pushes back.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Hehe! I suppose I shall have to keep pushing, then.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Harder and harder... until you fall! Haha!
Rapunzel advances, and Altruia is pushed back.
*Ksshhkkk!*
With a sound like shattering glass, Altruia's barrier erupts into pieces.
Still deploying her shield, Rapunzel closes in.
A massive energy barrier strikes Altruia head on.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: You're nothing but a false saint.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I am protected by our great mother. I will never suffer defeat.
Two arms extending from Altruia's back thrust forward.
*Grnnnggg*
They pierce through Rapunzel's shield. The arms are burnt to a crisp, turning into charcoal.
But they regenerate almost instantly.
Altruia's hands grab hold of Rapunzel's head.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Oh my! T-taking my head in your hands for a... k-kiss? At such a time as this?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I'm going to generate shields from both of my hands and crush your head.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Oh, so not a kiss.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: That's a relief. You are not my type.
*Bam!*
A loud crack echoes as a portion of Altruia's head vanishes.
As her head regenerates, Altruia stares at Rapunzel in astonishment.
Her gaze shifts above Rapunzel's head.
She sees a staff.
The red parts mounted on the head of the staff are vibrating.
*Vooooom*
The head of the staff is vibrating so intensely that it appears blurry.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Ultrasonic... vibrations?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Hyah!
Golden light pours out from the red parts.
Accelerated by the thrust, the staff strikes downward with explosive energy.
*Bammm!*
It smashes into Altruia's head.
Altruia is slammed into the ground, leaving a deep crater.
The hum of the vibration continues.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Oh wow... Th-this sound is a bit... dangerous. *Gasp*

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I-I can flip this switch to make the vibrations even stronger.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Sh-should I flip it?
*Click*
*Vooooom*
*Rrrrrrr*
The staff vibrates even more intensely. Altruia struggles desperately against the vibrations of the staff pressing down on her head.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: *Gnnnggghhh*

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: These ultrasonic vibrations actually break down nanomachines.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Here, have some more.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Aaaggghhh!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: By the way, aren't you going to transform?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: There's something I've been wanting to do.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I want to locate the weak point of a huge, powerful enemy,

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: and... assault it with my staff... Haha... hahaha!

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: This is... humiliating!

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Utterly... humiliating!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: That's supposed to be my line.
*Clank!*
The clear sound of steel rings through the air.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Tis thee, the Heretic who dared to mimic myself and Isabel.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Scarlet...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Thou knowest me.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Tis meet, I suppose, to learn the name of she whom thou doth imitate.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I have yearned to make acquaintance with thee. Thou knowest not...

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: ... how I have sought to bandy blows with thee!
*Clank, clank, clank!*
Scarlet and Egovista exchange sword strikes.
They attack faster than the eye can follow, yet neither yields an inch.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Oh...! What a delight! Verily, the sword is mightier than all else!

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: The clash of two swords conveys so much without words!

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Indeed, a single clang of steel says far more than a hundred words ever could! Hahaha!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: What meanest thou by this?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Using blades to converse? 'Tis idle dotage.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: A sword is but an instrument of death. How canst thou imagine it serve for discourse?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Ha, haha! I fear I did esteem thee too highly. I spake as if thou wert of understanding!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: In truth, I have heretofore heard such an idle musing. Though I knew it a fiction, it held some likelihood of truth.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: However, it doth suppose adversaries alike in strength.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Alas, thou art far too feeble.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: ... Thy sister was pitiful.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: But a single strike of my sword did cleave her in twain.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: The spectacle of her falling to the ground proved most amusing.
Egovista raises her sword.
She brings it down with all her might.
Scarlet lowers her stance and swiftly sheathes her sword at the same time.
Then, the moment she blinks and opens her eyes,
Egovista's sword is sliced in two and sent flying away through the air.
Sheathing her sword, Scarlet rises to her feet.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: ... What?
Egovista falls to her knees.
*Crack*
Her right shoulder splits open, and black liquid spurts out.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Thou art not worthy to dog my sister's heels.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Know thy place.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Cursed... human... imposter...

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Thou art drunk with a love of the blade,

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: yet depend upon thy brawn alone to wield it.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Tis unbefitting the name of swordsmanship. Desist henceforth to call it such.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: It abashes me to hear thee speak.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Silence... imposter...! Do not slander... my sword...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: It is a mystery where thou learned to wield a sword in so lamentable a manner.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... Oh, I understand.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Thy mother, so filled with dread of swords after I severed her head,

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: settled her opinion of what a sword should be, and thus fashioned thee.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: A confluence of prejudice and her own capricious ideals.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Haha. How ridiculous.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Ye call us imposters,

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: yet imitate us and desire to resemble us.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Does that not make you human imposter imposters, as the phrase is?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: By all means, transform.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Tis thy sole faculty, is it not?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: As you wish.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I shall grant your request.
*Screeeech!*

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I have heard this before...

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: ... The Queen's calling signal.
*Whoosh!*
The fallen Altruia and Egovista spring up into the air.
They instantly widen the distance between us and stare in our direction.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: ... Mother summons us.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I will never forget this humiliation.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: We shall see you dead. I swear.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Every last one of you.
Altruia and Egovista retreat toward the Lift from where the sound originated.
Shortly after, they disappear inside the Lift.
Scarlet and Rapunzel turn around.
Just as they are about to smile and say something,
Snow White steps forward.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Scarlet... Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Come quicker next time.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Must thou quench all cheer?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I feel silly for expecting anything else.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Wherefore art thou girt with such store of weapons? Art thou an armory? Show some restraint.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: You're... not wearing any pants. You're finally starting to see things the way I do...!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: What about you two? What's with all the stuff you've got?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Don't rely too much on your equipment.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... Thou has bereft me of all words.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Equipment is extremely important—essential, really, to bridge a difference in ability.
... Welcome back, you two.
I'm so relieved to see you again.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Ah, 'tis refreshing to hear. Thou alone dost offer so sincere a greeting.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: You seem even brawnier than when I last saw you, Believer.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: If you don't mind, may I touch... I mean... lick... I mean! May I massage you?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: That's the word you decided to go with?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Neither of you has changed a bit, I see.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: A great while has passed since last we met, Counters. Ye are all finely attired, I see.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: ... I can feel it. You've all grown stronger.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... Wait. Rapi. Thou art... changed...

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Ooh, is this new outfit of hers to your liking? You never spoke of such things before, but now...

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Red Hood?
Rapi quietly nods her head.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I have a lot to tell you two.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... I see. Discuss it to us hereafter.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Yeah. We'd love to hear all about it.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: By the way, who are these brazen sisters in black? They seem to be quite... bold.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh? Brazen?
They're the Four Beasts. They've agreed to help us in this fight.
... Er, they're Heretics, but they're on our side. You can trust them.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... I see. Thou art of a right sociable nature, my Lord.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: No kidding. You accept just about anyone as an ally.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Your range is... quite amazing.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Enough chit chat.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: We've finished declaring war, so now we fall back.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: For what reason? Being now arrived, should we not press forward?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I agree. It's a little anticlimactic to stop now.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: The Ark is going to initiate the Third Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: We wait until then.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: The Third Surface Reclamation War...?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I'll explain the details later.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: We're in the middle of enemy territory. Now's not the time.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Tis strange to hear such words from thy mouth.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Hehe, agreed.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Well then, let us turn back.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: We have journeyed thus far but to waste our strength.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Still, it wasn't all bad. We made quite the entrance, after all.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: We did, indeed.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You two.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Thanks for coming back.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Thou hast grown tender in our absence.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Thank you for holding on.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: And for staying alive.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: They will never lose.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: They're sure to win.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I, uh...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Can I keep cuddling with everyone?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: And go to new places,

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: and eat yummy food,

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: and laugh a lot,

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: and run around every day?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Really? Can I?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: You're allowed to keep living, surrounded by love.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: You know...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I really don't want to be the Queen.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Then I'll do it.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: For all those you care for, of course,

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: but also for everyone. I'll create a world where no one dies.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: A world where everyone loves and is loved in return.
The girl stares intently at Marian.
After nodding, she places her hand over her chest.
Her core glows red as black light drifts around it.
It moves toward Marian.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I'm going to do it. I promise.
